verses.english: A Question About the Fourth Absorption
“They speak of this thing called the ‘fourth absorption’.

verses.pali: ‘idha bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṁ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṁ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṁ catutthaṁ jhānaṁ upasampajja viharati.
verses.english: ‘It’s when, with the giving up of pleasure and pain and the disappearance of former happiness and sadness, a mendicant enters and remains in the fourth absorption, without pleasure or pain, with pure equanimity and mindfulness.
This is called the fourth absorption.’

verses.pali: So khvāhaṁ, āvuso, sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṁ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṁ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṁ catutthaṁ jhānaṁ upasampajja viharāmi.
verses.english: And so … I was entering and remaining in the fourth absorption.

verses.pali: Tassa mayhaṁ, āvuso, iminā vihārena viharato sukhasahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti.
verses.english: While I was in that meditation, perception and focus accompanied by pleasure beset me.

verses.pali: Atha kho maṁ, āvuso, bhagavā iddhiyā upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca:
verses.english: Then the Buddha came up to me with his psychic power and said,

verses.pali: Mā, brāhmaṇa, catutthaṁ jhānaṁ pamādo, catutthe jhāne cittaṁ saṇṭhapehi, catutthe jhāne cittaṁ ekodiṁ karohi, catutthe jhāne cittaṁ samādahā’ti.
verses.english: Don’t neglect the fourth absorption, brahmin! Settle your mind in the fourth absorption; unify your mind and immerse it in the fourth absorption.’

verses.pali: So khvāhaṁ, āvuso, aparena samayena sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṁ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṁ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṁ catutthaṁ jhānaṁ upasampajja vihāsiṁ.
verses.english: And so, after some time … I entered and remained in the fourth absorption.

verses.pali: Yañhi taṁ, āvuso, sammā vadamāno vadeyya …pe… mahābhiññataṁ patto”ti.
verses.english: So if anyone should be rightly called a disciple who attained to great direct knowledge with help from the Teacher, it’s me.”
